sharedMechanismsView.label: CEL-based conditional policy expression
sharedMechanismsView.description: Agentgateway uses CEL (cel.dev) expressions for both LLM virtual-model routing conditions (llm-cost-routing) and MCP tool-level authorization rules (mcp-authorization). Single expression language, two distinct application surfaces.
sharedMechanismsView.reopenTrigger: A future separate reviewed work order authorizes Model Gateway or CADP CEL-expression adoption

sharedMechanismsView.label: Text-only agent skill packaging (SKILL.md front-matter + body)
sharedMechanismsView.description: Both QM (skills-seed/*/SKILL.md) and DSH (.agents/skills/*/SKILL.md) use an identical shallow convention: YAML front-matter with name/description, Markdown body with usage guidance, optional references/ and scripts/ subfolders. This mirrors CVF's own ASSF skill-entry pattern.
sharedMechanismsView.planningDisposition: CONFIRMED_EXISTING; no new packaging mechanism, but instance content (specific skill bodies) may carry independent per-repo value
sharedMechanismsView.reopenTrigger: N/A; pattern already owned, only body-level content candidates are novel

sharedMechanismsView.label: Turn/session-provenance-gated privilege elevation
sharedMechanismsView.description: QM's admin skill elevates a chat agent's API token only on turns the admin started themselves; autonomous runs (cron/webhook) are refused elevation even if owned by an admin. Distinct from simple identity-based authorization.
sharedMechanismsView.existingCvfOwnerEvidence: EXTENSIONS/CVF_v1.6_AGENT_PLATFORM/cvf-web/src/lib/cadp-authorization.ts (identity separation present per EARA-AGW-T1 ESC-003=NO_NEW_VALUE finding)
sharedMechanismsView.reopenTrigger: A named CVF consumer needs turn-provenance (not just identity) as an authorization input

repositorySpecificValueViews.label: SPIFFE Workload API mTLS identity sourcing
repositorySpecificValueViews.userOutcome: Gateway and upstream both source rotating X.509-SVID identity from a local SPIFFE Workload API instead of static cert/key files; verified SPIFFE ID forwarded to backend via CEL source.spiffeId
repositorySpecificValueViews.producerVerifierConsumer: producer=gateway TLS layer; verifier=SPIFFE trust bundle check; consumer=upstream backend via forwarded header
repositorySpecificValueViews.invocationAndFailureBehavior: Only SVIDs chaining to the gateway's own trust-domain bundle are accepted; cross-trust-domain federation unsupported; pin specific upstream identities via subjectAltNames or CEL policy on source.spiffeId
repositorySpecificValueViews.existingCvfOwnerEvidenceOrGap: OWNER_SURFACE_NOT_FOUND at network/TCP layer per EARA-AGW-T1 ESC-007 finding; this example is the concrete mechanism instance of that named gap
repositorySpecificValueViews.missingCvfLink: No CVF network-layer mTLS/workload-identity owner surface exists yet
repositorySpecificValueViews.expectedBenefit: Would close the exact network-layer half of ESC-007 if a future tranche is authorized

repositorySpecificValueViews.reopenTrigger: Operator opens a network-layer identity tranche; do not implement from this pilot alone
